name: per_leg_sugar
what: open-loop, brain only: tarsal sugar drive at 50 Hz, read out as the firing rate of the proboscis motor neuron MN9 (the neural proxy for proboscis extension; the body is not stepped)

harness.note: the brain as scripts/assay_pathways.py builds it: Registry(policy), profiles.apply, connectome.build, lif.default_params, electrical.build; a fresh lif.Network per trial seeded default_rng(seed). No body, no sensory model, no Q10 (25 degC); noise per profile

readout.note: rate over the whole trial, averaged over the readout cells, then over trials. MN9 cells whose male_cns_extra statusLabel says they are incompletely traced are dropped (F-DATA-3: MN9_R has 633 inputs vs MN9_L's 6,358), which leaves MN9_L

bar_source: DECISIONS 21 Oct 02:33 (bars decided by the Director as Ben, 21 Oct; reversible): 'opens' is MN9_L above 5 Hz (mean of seeds 0-9) at 50 Hz leg sugar drive, the labellar bar. The rest of the four-part check of DECISIONS 6 Oct 00:41 (3 Hz silent, leg bitter silent, labellar bitter still suppresses) is not part of this item. A protocol bar for a qualitative behaviour (tarsal sugar evokes PER; Dethier 1976), not a measured MN9 rate
reference_script: scripts/assay_pathways.py --assay legsugar_mn9 --rates 50 --shuffles 0 --trials 10 --profile m10f0 (trials.csv readout_hz per trial)
evidence_status: spent: leg sugar at 50 Hz was the target of the s12 margin diagnostics (DECISIONS 6 Oct 00:41, F-TASTE-LEG-1, F-STAB-6), so this is a regression check, not held-out evidence
